pipeline_protocol: Logical CPU 2; Windows thread cycles; three warmups; separate untimed allocation probe; seven batches; four alternating processes per version. Requested iterations are three, with at least 64 for readers up to 65536 native bytes and 2048 for other outputs below 4096 bytes. Complete samples/palettes and independently modeled filtered bytes are checked outside timing. Fingerprints identify exact PNG wire input.
checkpoint_scope_note: Freeze-only source manifests retain the shared driver's default 12-iteration scope text but contain no timed outputs. Every paired record and TSV identifies the actual three-iteration request and per-case minimum.
fixture_scope: The existing 212 cases are unchanged: Stored-noise, native fixed-gradient and independently framed reference-zlib inputs, native gray/GA/RGB/RGBA8/16, indexed8, packed gray1/2/4, plain/Adam7, tails, Paeth controls and large outputs. All 513x257 reference streams assert dynamic first-block type 2.
in_process_protocol: Git baseline and selected crate link into one caller with shared native image types and copied optimized/LTO bench settings. Three processes retain eleven alternating batches per variant after one warmup. All 212 API comparisons check full samples/palettes and black-box complete Png results. Small cases use 512 iterations, large cases three. Public decoder object sizes and zero-limit owned memory are recorded outside timing.
retained_components: Buffered fixed blocks borrow immutable Huffman values, keeping local owned tables only for dynamic blocks
Streaming tables use None for fixed references and Some for dynamic ownership, omitting initial empty tables and fixed-block value copies
IHDR body uses the thirteen-byte fixed scratch buffer; signatures/chunk headers still consume eight bytes and CRCs use the existing four-byte prefix scratch
ownership_invariant: Dynamic code-length decoding only runs after successful Some construction. Completed dynamic literal/distance tables replace the code-length tree before Codes state. Fixed blocks select immutable references with None. Input suspension retains the existing state and dynamic ownership.
header_invariant: IHDR length thirteen is validated before its body enters scratch storage. Header parsing and Header event publication still happen after CRC verification. CRC input moves to prefix scratch only after an fdAT sequence prefix has been checked; prefix_have resets at each new non-discarded fdAT.
storage_tradeoff: Recorded x64 object sizes: Inflater 3896 to 3904 bytes; StreamDecoder 4680 to 4696 bytes. Zero-limit inflater owned memory 3904 to 3912 bytes. Measured basic PNG readers omit one 13-byte heap allocation; indexed cases instead remove an associated reallocation. Metadata sequences outside the timing corpus can reuse capacity differently.
serialization: Our builds, measurements and validation jobs are serialized. Other host workloads, CPU frequency and preemption are uncontrolled. Separate-process reader controls vary despite unchanged component logic; both datasets and all process ranges are retained without a universal speedup claim.
source_line_endings: PNG source matches recorded Git LF bytes. The unchanged shared deadlib-image/src/lib.rs checkout is CRLF while Git stores LF; audit checks the documented normalization. Report digest describes Git-normalized LF text, while measurement/source-manifest/executable identities retain exact bytes.
test_changes: Integration tests, independent support generators, fixtures and library oracles remain unchanged. Full malformed Huffman/permutation, prefix/trailer, PNG/APNG, CRC/sequence, partial-input and resource/I/O suites verify the new ownership and reused scratch paths.
